Author(s): Martin J. A. Schuetz, Romina Yalovetzky, Ruben S. Andrist, Grant Salton, Yue Sun, Rudy Raymond, Shouvanik Chakrabarti, Atithi Acharya, Ruslan Shaydulin, Marco Pistoia, and Helmut G. Katzgraber

We propose and implement a quantum-informed reduction algorithm for the maximum independent set problem that integrates classical kernelization techniques with information extracted from quantum devices.
